messages:
maria.chen: Drafting a lightweight "continuous acceptance" proposal for onboarding new catalog models. Goal: faster onboarding with safety gates + customer adapter lane. Please review and flag missing thresholds by EOD Fri.
kevin.patel: Can you enumerate the acceptance gates we9ll require? latency / cost / quality specifics?
maria.chen: Proposed gates: p95 latency <= 120ms on default instance class; token-cost delta <= +10% vs current pinned model; hallucination/regression < 2% on the model9s eval suite; semantic parity for rerank top-k >= 98%. Must pass smoke prompts and infra CI.
anya: Add per-customer "owned prompts" check. We should generate a diff report that highlights tokenization or output-shift examples for each customer opting into the adapter.
sam: Agreed. Also propose a "pin override" flow: customers on paid plans can request a temporary per-customer pin while they validate. How long is adapter intended to run?
maria.chen: Adapters = pre/post transforms (tokenizer mapping + small post-process shims) to maintain parity for customer workloads. Lifecycle: opt-in, 30-90 day window, auditable change history. Not for general availability, only to smooth cutovers.
leo.kim: On the infra side, suggest 1% live canary for 24h with a synthetic ramp to validate KV cache warmup. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% OR p95 latency degradation > 20% vs baseline. Also capture warm-start vs cold-start metrics.
kevin.patel: Add cost rollback: automated rollback if cost-per-1k tokens delta > 25% sustained for 24h. Ensure billing teams are notified in the rollout ticket.
maria.chen: Example rollout manifest (POC): ```json { "model": "open-xyz-7b-v2", "canary_percent": 1, "canary_duration_minutes": 1440, "acceptance_metrics": { "p95_latency_ms": 120, "token_cost_delta_pct": 10, "hallucination_pct": 2, "semantic_parity_pct": 98 }, "fallback": "pin-to-previous", "adapter_enabled": true } ```
anya: Tie this into the eval-harness so we can auto-run regression and smoke suites pre-rollout and post-canary. Also include a small randomized NPS prompt for qualitative feedback during canary.
sam: For customer comms: one-pager that explains adapters (what they are, duration, how to request pin override). Legal needs to sign off on the SLA language for pin windows.
product-bot: Reminder: Roadmap sync Tue 10:00 — add this under "catalog governance" agenda.
kevin.patel: Suggest including a per-model "migration scorecard" in the catalog UI showing pass/fail by gate, percentage delta for cost/latency, and customer opt-ins.
maria.chen: Good call. Next steps: I9ll update the proposal doc with explicit thresholds, adapter lifecycle, rollout manifest template, and the customer comms ticket template. Scheduling 30m design review Mon 11:00. Thanks :pray:
__note: Single-thread Slack conversation capturing product discussion on model onboarding acceptance criteria, customer adapters, canary configuration, and rollback triggers. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender name.
